note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the proposition is the author's illustrative text, not a statement of any law. Which situations lie inside each cord is supplied by the author; outside only means 'not examined', never excluded or decided.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional residents' club: the same four notice situations on two maps; situation 2 (the annex hall board) is supplied as covered in A and as not examined in B, so only A's cord takes it in.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a fictional library note with five situations; the changed one is situation 4 (a book left on the front steps), supplied as not examined in A and as covered in B — the wider loop is now in B.

rules.title: Note 7 of the residents' club of the north block, as circulated in spring (fictional)
rules.proposition: Members are treated as told of a general meeting when its notice has been pinned on the main hall board at least seven days before it takes place

facts.text: Notice pinned on the main hall board eight days before the spring meeting
Notice pinned on the board of the annex hall across the courtyard
Notice pinned on the main board and also read out at the previous meeting
Notice sent only as a text message to the members' group chat
Member living abroad for the whole month before the meeting took place
Notice slipped under each flat door by a neighbour the evening before

issues: Does Note 7 say anything about notices that were only sent as messages?
Is the annex hall board treated in the same way as the main hall board?
assumptions: Only the situations listed in Note 7 were examined when it was written
The dates on the notices are taken exactly as supplied
